blocks.text: Software development ek systematic (tarteeb aur qaide wala) process hai jo users ki zarooraton (needs) ko software products mein badalta hai. Is mein kai stages (hisse) hoti hain: shuru ke analysis (jaanch) se le kar design, coding, testing aur deployment tak. Har stage ki apni ahmiyat hai aur har stage ke liye khaas skills aur tools chahiye hote hain. Software development ka process samajhna zaroori hai ta ke hum reliable (bharosay ke qabil), maintainable (aasani se theek aur update hone wala) aur scalable (barhne ke qabil) software bana sakein. Yeh chapter software development ke basic (bunyadi) concepts sikhata hai: aham terms, Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), software development methodologies (kaam karne ke tareeqe), project planning aur management, quality assurance aur software design patterns.

blocks.prompt: Software development kis cheez ko kis cheez mein badalta hai, aur is ki stages kaun si hain?
blocks.explanation: Yeh users ki zarooraton (needs) ko software products mein badalta hai. Stages: analysis, design, coding, testing aur deployment. Har stage ke liye khaas skills aur tools chahiye.

items: Software development: users ki needs se software product tak ek systematic process.
Is chapter mein: terms, SDLC, methodologies, project planning aur management, quality assurance, design patterns.
